```{r }
library(tidyverse)    # 数据清洗与处理 (包含 dplyr, tidyr 等)
library(lubridate)    # 日期与时间处理
library(readxl)       # 读取 Excel 文件
library(glmmTMB)      # 拟合广义线性混合模型 (GLMM)
library(broom.mixed)  # 整洁地提取混合模型参数与置信区间
library(DHARMa)       # 模型残差诊断与假设检验 (零膨胀、过离散)
library(MuMIn)        # 计算模型的 R-squared
library(emmeans)      # 计算估计边际均值 (Estimated Marginal Means)
library(knitr)

# 1. 读取相机工作历史表
camera_info <- read_excel("Fuzhou_Camera_info.xlsx")

# 2. 生成长表并计算“各季节”工作时长 (Season_Duration)
seasonal_effort <- camera_info %>%
  dplyr::select(Location, Camera, starts_with("Install"), starts_with("Check")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("Install", "Check")),
    names_to = c(".value", "Period_ID"),
    names_pattern = "(Install|Check)(\\d+)",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Install = ymd(Install),
    Check = ymd(Check)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Install) & !is.na(Check)) %>%
  # 展开为逐日序列
  mutate(Daily_Sequence = map2(Install, Check, ~seq(.x, .y, by = "day"))) %>%
  unnest(Daily_Sequence) %>%
  # 划分季节
  mutate(
    Month = month(Daily_Sequence),
    Season = case_when(
      Month %in% c(3, 4, 10, 11, 12) ~ "Migration",
      Month %in% c(5, 6, 7, 8, 9) ~ "Summer",
      Month %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Winter"
    )
  ) %>%
  # 汇总按季节的时长
  group_by(Location, Camera, Season) %>%
  summarise(
    Season_Duration = n(), # 修改点：命名为季节有效工作时长
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

camera_total_duration <- seasonal_effort %>%
  group_by(Camera) %>%
  summarise(Duration_1 = sum(Season_Duration), .groups = 'drop')

camera_info <- camera_info %>%
  left_join(camera_total_duration, by = "Camera")



```
#计算RAI（新）
```{r}
data <- read_excel("Data.xlsx")
speciescount <- read_excel("species_inventory.xlsx")
#对接物种中文英文名
data <- merge(data,speciescount,by.x="Species",by.y = "Chinese_Name",all.x = TRUE)
data_clean <- data %>% dplyr::select(Location, Camera, Common_Name, Taxonomy, Date, Number)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# 1. 清除名录遗漏导致的无效行 (Common_Name 为 NA)
data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(Common_Name))

data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  filter(Camera %in% camera_info$Camera)

# 2. 计算福山和旗山各自的相机总监测时间长度
# 根据你提供的表格结构，直接使用 camera_info 中的 Duration 列
location_effort <- camera_info %>%
  group_by(Location) %>%
  summarise(Total_Duration = sum(Duration_1, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 3. 按 Location 和 Common_Name 计算加权物种数量，并推算新 RAI
new_rai_calc <- data_clean %>%
  # 按照 Number 加权算出每个物种拍摄到的数量
  group_by(Location, Common_Name) %>%
  summarise(Weighted_Count = sum(Number, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # 对接总监测时长
  left_join(location_effort, by = "Location") %>%
  # 计算新 RAI: (数量 / 总时长) * 100
  mutate(New_RAI = (Weighted_Count / Total_Duration) * 100)

# 4. 将长表转为宽表 (分列展示福山和旗山)，以便与旧表无缝对接
new_rai_wide <- new_rai_calc %>%
  dplyr::select(Common_Name, Location, New_RAI) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Location,
    values_from = New_RAI,
    names_prefix = "New_",      # 生成 New_Fushan 和 New_Qishan 的列名
    values_fill = list(New_RAI = 0) # 如果某物种在另一个样地没拍到，RAI 自动补 0
  ) %>%
  rename(New_Fushan_RAI = New_Fushan, New_Qishan_RAI = New_Qishan)

# 5. 与 speciescount 中的旧 RAI 进行对比提取
rai_comparison <- speciescount %>%
  # 保留需要的列，重命名以防混淆
  dplyr::select(Common_Name, Old_Fushan_RAI = Fushan_RAI, Old_Qishan_RAI = Qishan_RAI) %>%
  # 使用 inner_join 只对比我们在 data_clean 中有记录的有效物种
  inner_join(new_rai_wide, by = "Common_Name") %>%
  # 调整列顺序，将新旧数值放在相邻列直观对比
  dplyr::select(
    Common_Name,
    Old_Fushan_RAI, New_Fushan_RAI,
    Old_Qishan_RAI, New_Qishan_RAI
  ) %>%
  # 保留两位小数，方便肉眼比对
  mutate(
    Old_Fushan_RAI = round(as.numeric(Old_Fushan_RAI), 2),
    New_Fushan_RAI = round(New_Fushan_RAI, 2),
    Old_Qishan_RAI = round(as.numeric(Old_Qishan_RAI), 2),
    New_Qishan_RAI = round(New_Qishan_RAI, 2)
  )

# 查看最终对比结果
print(rai_comparison)

library(openxlsx)

# 1. 将新计算的 RAI 合并回原始名录表
speciescount_updated <- speciescount %>%
  # 【核心修复点】：防御性删除。
  # 使用 any_of()，如果表里存在这俩列就先删掉，如果不存在也不会报错。
  # 这样确保每次 run 都能干干净净地拼接最新的计算结果。
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("RAI_Fushan_n", "RAI_Qishan_n"))) %>%
  
  # 使用 left_join 确保不会丢失物种名录中原有的任何一行
  left_join(new_rai_wide, by = "Common_Name") %>%
  
  # 2. 将列名重命名为你要求的名称
  rename(
    RAI_Fushan_n = New_Fushan_RAI,
    RAI_Qishan_n = New_Qishan_RAI
  ) %>%
  
  # 3. 数据清理：如果某物种在本次数据中完全没记录，合并后会是 NA，将其替换为 0
  mutate(
    RAI_Fushan_n = replace_na(RAI_Fushan_n, 0),
    RAI_Qishan_n = replace_na(RAI_Qishan_n, 0)
  )

# 查看合并后的前几行，确保列名和数据正确
head(speciescount_updated)

# 4. 输出并覆盖保存为原本的 Excel 文件
#write.xlsx(speciescount_updated, "species_inventory.xlsx", rowNames = FALSE)

cat("新的 RAI 列已成功写入，并已导出至 species_inventory.xlsx 文件。\n")

```

#计算相机间距离
```{r}
# 加载必要的包
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(geosphere) # 用于计算经纬度球面距离
library(knitr)

# 1. 读取并清洗相机数据
camera_info <- read_excel("Fuzhou_Camera_info.xlsx")

cam_coords <- camera_info %>%
  # 剔除坐标中的非数字字符 (如 °N, °E) 并转为数值型
  mutate(
    Latitude = as.numeric(str_replace_all(Latitude, "[^0-9.]", "")),
    Longitude = as.numeric(str_replace_all(Longitude, "[^0-9.]", "")),
    Elevation = as.numeric(Elevation)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Location, Camera, Longitude, Latitude, Elevation) %>%
  drop_na(Latitude, Longitude, Elevation)

# 2. 编写提取“最近邻距离 (NND)”的核心函数
get_nn_distances <- function(df) {
  # 如果该样地相机少于2台，无法计算距离
  if(nrow(df) < 2) return(numeric(0)) 
  
  # A. 计算 2D 球面距离矩阵 (单位: 米)
  dist2d_mat <- distm(df[, c("Longitude", "Latitude")])
  
  # B. 计算海拔垂直差矩阵 (单位: 米)
  elev_mat <- as.matrix(dist(df$Elevation))
  
  # C. 勾股定理合成 3D 距离矩阵
  dist3d_mat <- sqrt(dist2d_mat^2 + elev_mat^2)
  
  # D. 核心操作：将自己到自己的距离 (对角线的0) 设为 NA，防止被当成最小值提取
  diag(dist3d_mat) <- NA
  
  # E. 按行寻找每台相机的最短距离 (即最近的一台相机的距离)
  nn_dists <- apply(dist3d_mat, 1, min, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  return(nn_dists)
}

# 3. 分别计算各组相机的最近邻距离向量
fushan_nn <- get_nn_distances(cam_coords %>% filter(Location == "Fushan"))
qishan_nn <- get_nn_distances(cam_coords %>% filter(Location == "Qishan"))

# 计算总体：将两地的所有“最近邻距离”汇总在一起
overall_nn <- c(fushan_nn, qishan_nn)

# 4. 汇总统计 Mean 和 SD
distance_summary <- tibble(
  Scope = c("Fushan", "Qishan", "Overall"),
  Mean_Nearest_Distance_m = c(mean(fushan_nn), mean(qishan_nn), mean(overall_nn)),
  SD_Nearest_Distance_m = c(sd(fushan_nn), sd(qishan_nn), sd(overall_nn)),
  Camera_Count = c(length(fushan_nn), length(qishan_nn), length(overall_nn))
) %>%
  mutate(
    # 保留两位小数
    Mean_Nearest_Distance_m = round(Mean_Nearest_Distance_m, 2),
    SD_Nearest_Distance_m = round(SD_Nearest_Distance_m, 2)
  )

# 5. 打印结果
kable(distance_summary, format = "markdown")
```


#GLMM建模
```{r}
library(glmmTMB)
library(MuMIn)
data <- read_excel("Data.xlsx")
speciescount <- read_excel("species_inventory.xlsx")
#对接物种中文英文名
data <- merge(data,speciescount,by.x="Species",by.y = "Chinese_Name",all.x = TRUE)
data <- data %>% filter(Taxonomy %in% c("Bird","Mammal"))
data_clean <- data %>% dplyr::select(Location, Camera, Common_Name, Taxonomy, Date, Number)

data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  filter(!Camera %in% c("FT10", "FT11", "FT12", "FT13", "FT14")) %>%
  
  mutate(Camera = case_when(
    Camera == "QT7" ~ "Q7",
    Camera == "QT10" ~ "Q10",
    TRUE ~ Camera # Keep all other camera names the same
  )) %>%
  
  arrange(Camera)

glmm_input_seasonal <- data_clean %>%
  filter(!Common_Name %in% c("bat", "rat", "shrew", "leaf warbler")) %>%
  
  # 判定物种记录所在的季节（需与时长计算标准绝对一致）
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(Date),
    Month = month(Date),
    Season = case_when(
      Month %in% c(3, 4, 10, 11, 12) ~ "Migration",
      Month %in% c(5, 6, 7, 8, 9) ~ "Summer",
      Month %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Winter"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # 分季节统计物种数量
  group_by(Location, Camera, Taxonomy, Season) %>% 
  summarise(
    Species_Number = n_distinct(Common_Name[Common_Name != "No_Species_Detected"]),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  # 结合第一步的工作时长数据 (使用 right_join 确保所有实际工作的季节都有记录基础)
  right_join(seasonal_effort, by = c("Location", "Camera", "Season")) %>%
  
  # 将由于 merge 产生的未拍到动物的 Species_Number 的 NA 替换为 0
  mutate(Species_Number = replace_na(Species_Number, 0)) %>%
  
  # 补齐零值：利用 nesting 确保每个【实际存在工作时间的】Camera+Season 组合下，
  # 必定同时具有 Mammal 和 Bird 的行 (即便都是 0)
  complete(nesting(Location, Camera, Season, Season_Duration), Taxonomy, fill = list(Species_Number = 0)) %>%
  
  # 清理由于 right_join 可能产生的 Taxonomy 为 NA 的空行
  filter(!is.na(Taxonomy)) %>%
  
  # 安全起见，确保只有工作天数 > 0 的记录进入模型，避免 log(0) 错误
  filter(Season_Duration > 0)
```

#模型运行
```{r}
library(glmmTMB)

# 拟合 GLMM 模型
model_season_glmm <- glmmTMB(
  Species_Number ~ Location + Taxonomy + Season + offset(log(Season_Duration)) + (1|Camera),
  data = glmm_input_seasonal, 
  family = nbinom2 # 负二项分布处理过离散
)

model_season_glmm <- glmmTMB(
  Species_Number ~ Location + Taxonomy + Season + offset(log(Season_Duration)) + (1|Camera),
  data = glmm_input_seasonal, 
  family = poisson(link = "log")
)

model_season_glmm <- glmmTMB(
  Species_Number ~ Location + Taxonomy + Season + log(Season_Duration) + (1|Camera),
  data = glmm_input_seasonal, 
  family = poisson(link = "log")
)

model_season_glmm <- glmmTMB(
  Species_Number ~ Location + Taxonomy + Season + log(Season_Duration) + (1|Camera),
  data = glmm_input_seasonal, 
  family = nbinom2
)

model_season_glmm <- glmmTMB(
  Species_Number ~ Location* Taxonomy +Season+ log(Season_Duration) + (1|Camera), 
  data = glmm_input_seasonal, 
  family = poisson(link = "log")
)

model_season_glmm <- glmmTMB(
  Species_Number ~ Location* Taxonomy +Season* Taxonomy+ log(Season_Duration) + (1|Camera), 
  data = glmm_input_seasonal, 
  family = poisson(link = "log")
)

summary(model_season_glmm)
```

#模型解释力和严谨性诊断
```{r}
# 提取固定效应和随机效应的 95% 置信区间 (制表用)
# conf.int = TRUE 默认计算置信区间，effects = "all" 提取包括随机效应方差在内的所有参数
tidy_results <- tidy(model_season_glmm, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "ran_pars")
print("===== 模型系数与 95% CI =====")
print(tidy_results)
(exp(0.17436422)^2)

model_ci <- confint(model_season_glmm, method = "profile")
print(model_ci)

# 提取模型的解释力 (R-squared) 
# 使用 trigamma 方法精确计算非正态模型的 R2m (固定效应) 和 R2c (总体)
r2_overall <- r.squaredGLMM(model_season_glmm)
print("===== 模型的边际与条件 R-squared (选用 trigamma 行) =====")
print(r2_overall)

# ==============================================================================
# 4. 模型严谨性诊断 (DHARMa 包)
# ==============================================================================
# 生成模拟残差 (基础)
simulated_res <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model_season_glmm, plot = TRUE)

# 执行各项学术级统计检验 (控制台会输出 P 值)
testDispersion(simulated_res)         # 检验过离散 (p>0.05则通过)
testZeroInflation(simulated_res)      # 检验零膨胀 (p>0.05则通过)

# ==============================================================================
# 5. 标准化边际均值预测 (emmeans) - 用于汇报模型预测值
# ==============================================================================
# 剔除各相机时长不一的干扰，计算标准化条件下的期望物种发生率
# 设定 offset = log(100) 统一标准为“每100个工作日”
pred_emmeans <- emmeans(model_season_glmm, 
                        specs = ~ Location + Taxonomy, 
                        # 使用 at 列表来指定连续变量的取值，预测第 100 天时的物种累积量
                        at = list(Season_Duration = 100), 
                        type = "response")

print("===== 100个工作日标准下的模型预测物种数与置信区间 =====")
print(pred_emmeans)

library(emmeans)

# 1. 计算各个组合的边际均值（假设 Season_Duration = 100）
pred_emmeans_int <- emmeans(model_season_glmm, 
                            specs = ~ Taxonomy | Location, # 这个语法表示：在每个 Location 内部，对比不同 Taxonomy
                            at = list(Season_Duration = 100), 
                            type = "response")

# 2. 打印出各个组的预测值
print(pred_emmeans_int)

# 3. 进行事后两两对比（找出隐藏的显著性）
# 这将直接告诉你：福山的鸟和兽差异多少？旗山的鸟和兽差异多少？
pairwise_comparisons <- pairs(pred_emmeans_int)
print(pairwise_comparisons)

# ==============================================================================
# 6. 生成附录/描述性统计摘要表：各相机原始数据与百天发现率
# ==============================================================================
# 该表呈现最真实的 Raw Data 与简单粗速率，解释为什么模型得出了均值反转的结果
camera_wide <- data_clean %>%
  filter(Taxonomy %in% c("Mammal", "Bird")) %>%
  filter(!Common_Name %in% c("No_Species_Detected", "bat", "rat", "shrew")) %>%
  group_by(Location, Camera, Taxonomy) %>%
  summarise(
    Species_Count = n_distinct(Common_Name),
    Species_List = paste(sort(unique(Common_Name)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Taxonomy,
    values_from = c(Species_Count, Species_List),
    values_fill = list(Species_Count = 0, Species_List = "None") 
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Bird_Count = Species_Count_Bird, Mammal_Count = Species_Count_Mammal,
    Bird_List = Species_List_Bird, Mammal_List = Species_List_Mammal
  )
```

#检查数据：每台相机的物种数和工作时长
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr) # 用于输出整洁的Markdown表格

# 1. 提取每台相机的总工作时长 (Total_Duration)
# 这里假设上一回合中生成的 camera_info 已包含 Duration_1 列
camera_effort <- camera_info %>%
  dplyr::select(Location, Camera, Total_Duration = Duration_1)

# 2. 从原始记录数据中分类提取并汇总鸟类和哺乳动物的信息
camera_species_summary <- data_clean %>%
  # 剔除无效记录和小型哺乳动物
  filter(Taxonomy %in% c("Mammal", "Bird")) %>%
  filter(!Common_Name %in% c("No_Species_Detected", "bat", "rat", "shrew")) %>%
  
  # 按样地、相机和类群分组汇总
  group_by(Location, Camera, Taxonomy) %>%
  summarise(
    Species_Count = n_distinct(Common_Name),
    # 将该相机拍到的所有该类群物种名拼接到一起
    Species_List = paste(sort(unique(Common_Name)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. 宽表转换：将鸟类和哺乳动物的数据分列展示
camera_wide <- camera_species_summary %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Taxonomy,
    values_from = c(Species_Count, Species_List),
    # 填充 0 和 "None"，防止某台相机完全没拍到某一类群
    values_fill = list(Species_Count = 0, Species_List = "None") 
  ) %>%
  # 规范列名
  rename(
    Bird_Count = Species_Count_Bird,
    Mammal_Count = Species_Count_Mammal,
    Bird_List = Species_List_Bird,
    Mammal_List = Species_List_Mammal
  )

# 4. 结合工作时长，计算每百天物种发现率，并整理最终表格
camera_final_table <- camera_effort %>%
  left_join(camera_wide, by = c("Location", "Camera")) %>%
  # 处理可能因为从头到尾什么动物都没拍到而产生的 NA
  mutate(
    across(c(Bird_Count, Mammal_Count), ~replace_na(.x, 0)),
    across(c(Bird_List, Mammal_List), ~replace_na(.x, "None"))
  ) %>%
  # 核心计算：粗速率 (每百天拍到多少种)
  mutate(
    Bird_Per_100d = round((Bird_Count / Total_Duration) * 100, 2),
    Mammal_Per_100d = round((Mammal_Count / Total_Duration) * 100, 2)
  ) %>%
  # 调整列的顺序以便于查看
  dplyr::select(
    Location,
    Camera,
    Total_Duration,
    Bird_Count,
    Bird_Per_100d,
    Mammal_Count,
    Mammal_Per_100d,
    Bird_List,
    Mammal_List
  ) %>%
  # 排序：先按样地排，再按总有效时长降序排列
  arrange(Location, desc(Total_Duration))

# 5. 打印精美表格 (可以直接在 RStudio 或控制台查看)
# 使用 kable 可以在输出时自动对齐，适合检查
kable(camera_final_table, format = "markdown")

library(openxlsx)
# 可选：如果你想把这个表格导出到 Excel 里慢慢看
write.xlsx (camera_final_table, "Camera_Detailed_Summary.xlsx", rowNames = FALSE)

```
